en.name: Barbecue sauce, homemade and canned
en.summary: This is barbecue sauce made at home and preserved by canning in sealed jars, not a sauce simply cooked and poured into a bottle. Properly processed and sealed, it keeps about 9–12 months in the cupboard. Once a jar is opened it is an ordinary refrigerated condiment.
en.pantry: Sealed jars keep about 9–12 months in a cool, dark, dry cupboard. That figure assumes the sauce was made to a tested recipe and processed properly, which for a tomato-based sauce means an acidity level the recipe was designed around — home canning is where guesswork turns into a botulism risk, and a sauce you improvised is not a sauce you should shelf-store. Label every jar with the date, store them without their screw bands so a failed seal shows itself, and check each lid is still concave before use.
en.fridge: Once a jar is opened, keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, capped, and use it as you would any opened condiment. A jar that failed to seal properly never belonged in the cupboard at all: refrigerate it immediately and use it quickly, or freeze it. The same goes for any batch you cooked but did not process — that is a fresh sauce, not a preserve.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for home-canned barbecue sauce, but freezing is a perfectly sensible alternative to canning for anyone without proper equipment, and it sidesteps the acidity question entirely. Cool the sauce, portion it into rigid containers or flat bags leaving headspace for expansion, and freeze at −18 °C (0 °F). Frozen food held at that temperature stays safe indefinitely; what drifts is flavour and texture.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen barbecue sauce in the fridge overnight, or reheat it gently straight from frozen in a pan. Do not thaw it on the counter, and whisk it if it has separated.
spoilage: A lid that has lost its seal, flexes, or pops up when pressed
Spurting liquid, fizzing or pressure when the jar is opened
Mould on the surface, under the lid or around the rim
A fermented or yeasty smell, or a sauce that has visibly darkened and separated
tips: Use a tested recipe; do not improvise the acid in anything you intend to shelf-store.
Date every jar and work through them oldest first.
Store without screw bands so a failed seal is obvious.
When in doubt, freeze instead of canning — it is the forgiving option.

faq.q: How long does home-canned barbecue sauce last?
faq.a: About 9–12 months in a cool, dark cupboard, provided the jars were processed to a tested recipe and are properly sealed.

faq.q: Can you freeze homemade barbecue sauce?
faq.a: Yes, and it is the safer route if you are not set up for canning. Cool it, portion it with headspace and freeze at −18 °C.

faq.q: What if a jar did not seal?
faq.a: It is not shelf-stable. Refrigerate it straight away and use it quickly, or freeze it.

faq.q: How can you tell if home-canned sauce has gone bad?
faq.a: A lid that has lost its seal, spurting or fizzing on opening, mould, or a fermented smell. Discard the jar without tasting it.

zh.name: 自製封罐烤肉醬
zh.summary: 這裡指的是在家做好、以裝罐密封方式保存的烤肉醬，不是煮好後隨手倒進瓶子的醬。處理與密封得當的話，放在櫥櫃裡大約 9～12 個月。一旦開罐，它就是一般的冷藏調味料。
zh.pantry: 密封完好的罐子放在陰涼、避光、乾燥的櫥櫃，大約 9～12 個月。這個數字的前提是照著經過驗證的配方製作並正確殺菌處理；對番茄基底的醬來說，那代表整體酸度必須符合配方的設計——家庭裝罐正是「憑感覺」變成肉毒桿菌風險的地方，自己隨意調的醬不該常溫存放。每罐都標日期，存放時把外圈螺蓋拆掉，這樣密封失敗會立刻顯現，使用前也要確認蓋子仍然是凹陷的。
zh.fridge: 開罐後放 4 °C 以下、蓋緊，比照一般開封調味料使用。密封失敗的罐子本來就不該進櫥櫃：請立刻冷藏並盡快用完，或改成冷凍。煮好但沒有做殺菌處理的那一鍋也一樣——那是新鮮醬料，不是保存品。
zh.freezer: 自製封罐烤肉醬沒有公布冷凍期限，但對沒有裝罐設備的人來說，冷凍是非常合理的替代方案，而且完全繞開酸度的問題。醬放涼後分裝進硬質容器或平放的密封袋，留出膨脹空間，放 −18 °C 冷凍。食物在這個溫度下安全性可以無限期維持，會變的是風味和質地。
zh.thawing: 冷凍的烤肉醬請放冷藏隔夜解凍，或直接從冷凍下鍋小火加熱。不要放室溫解凍；如果有分離，攪拌回去即可。
spoilage: 蓋子失去真空、按下去會彈動或彈起
開罐時液體噴出、冒氣或有壓力
醬面、蓋子內側或瓶口周圍長霉
有發酵味或酵母味，或醬色明顯變深並分層
tips: 使用經過驗證的配方；打算常溫存放的醬，酸度不要自己亂改。
每罐標上日期，先做先用。
存放時拆掉外圈螺蓋，密封失敗才看得出來。
拿不準就改冷凍，那是容錯率最高的做法。

faq.q: 自製封罐的烤肉醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 只要依照驗證配方處理且密封完好，陰涼避光的櫥櫃大約 9～12 個月。

faq.q: 自製烤肉醬可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 可以，而且如果你沒有裝罐設備，冷凍更安全。放涼、留膨脹空間分裝，放 −18 °C。

faq.q: 罐子沒有密封成功怎麼辦？
faq.a: 那就不是常溫保存品。請立刻冷藏並盡快用完，或改成冷凍。

faq.q: 怎麼判斷自製封罐醬壞掉了？
faq.a: 蓋子失去真空、開罐噴濺或冒氣、長霉、有發酵味。直接整罐丟掉，不要試吃。
